steps.say: Rounding finds the nearest ten or hundred. A number line helps.

figure.alt: A number line from 40 to 50 with 47 marked.

steps.say: 47 is between 40 and 50. It is closer to 50.
Look at the ones digit. 5 or more rounds up, and less than 5 rounds down.
To round to the nearest 100, look at the tens digit.

figure.alt: A number line from 300 to 400 with 360 marked.

steps.say: 360 has 6 tens, so it rounds up to 400.

hints: A ones digit less than 5 rounds down.
check.explanation: 73 is between 70 and 80. The ones digit is 3, so 73 rounds down to 70.

hints: A tens digit of 5 or more rounds up.
check.explanation: 650 is halfway between 600 and 700. Halfway numbers round up, so 650 rounds to 700.
